body:
Parent issue: #37

Stage: caption-infra

## Task

Implement the caption rendering infrastructure for the Augmented Mind podcast site.

## Goal
Add a collapsible Transcript component that episode pages can optionally display when captionEn and/or captionZh frontmatter fields are set.

## Files to create/modify

### 1. `quartz/components/Transcript.tsx` (new)
- A Quartz component that reads `captionEn` and `captionZh` from the current page's frontmatter
- Renders a `<details>` block with `<summary>Transcript</summary>` below the video
- If both EN and ZH captions exist, show language toggle tabs (EN / ZH); if only one exists, show it directly
- Caption files are markdown files stored at paths like `/captions/ep00.en.md` — the component should read their content at build time using Quartz's resource system (similar to how other components access file content)
- Use clean paragraph text rendering (no VTT timestamps)
- Style: use existing CSS variables (e.g. var(--light), var(--secondary)) for consistency; dark mode compatible

### 2. `quartz/components/index.ts`
- Export `Transcript` alongside existing component exports

### 3. `quartz.layout.ts`
- Import and register `Transcript` in the episode page layout's `afterBody` slot
- Condition: only render on episode pages (check the existing `isEpisodePage` helper or equivalent pattern already used for the YouTube embed / episode header)

### 4. `content/captions/.gitkeep` (new)
- Empty placeholder file to create the captions directory in git

## Frontmatter convention (document via code comments)
Episode markdown files may include:
```yaml
captionEn: /captions/ep00.en.md
captionZh: /captions/ep00.zh.md
```
No existing episode files need to be modified — this is opt-in.

## Constraints
- Follow the existing Quartz component pattern (look at Content.tsx, Header.tsx, etc. for reference)
- Do not modify any existing episode .md files
- The component must gracefully do nothing when neither captionEn nor captionZh is present in frontmatter
- The parent issue is #37
